title: RSPO: Reward-Swap Policy Optimization for Multi-Turn LLM Agents
quote: directly training with outcome rewards often results in slow convergence due to the sparsity of signals and the lack of fine-grained feedback. Furthermore, the model may fail to learn successful trajectories that are not sampled during training, thereby limiting its performance.
problem: With only an end-of-episode reward, agents learn slowly and never discover the good behaviors they happen not to sample, so training plateaus.
recipe_failure: On-policy GRPO only reinforces what it samples; rare successful behaviors outside the current policy's reach are never learned.
trick: Train a helper policy with dense hand-made process rewards to explore widely, store its trajectories, then train the final policy only on the true sparse outcome reward while replaying those stored trajectories as off-policy data.

recipe_failure: GRPO on dense surrogate rewards optimizes the surrogate, not the task.
